comparisons.metric: end-to-end wall-clock, s (accuracy: Sim(3) camera-centre RMSE vs shipped reference)
comparisons.protocol: Both engines end-to-end on the same machine (i7-9750H, GTX 1660 Ti), both frontends GPU. COLMAP 4.1.0 CUDA defaults (SIFT + exhaustive + mapper) vs visloc SuperPoint-2048 + unordered_sfm_demo --colmap-style; both scored vs the dataset's shipped COLMAP reference by Sim(3).
comparisons.notes: Speed win (2.67x) at sub-cm accuracy parity and full registration. Accuracy column measures agreement with COLMAP's own historical solution, on which COLMAP has home advantage (0.15 cm is COLMAP-reproduces-COLMAP); not independent ground truth.

comparisons.metric: end-to-end wall-clock, s (accuracy: Sim(3) camera-centre RMSE vs shipped reference)
comparisons.protocol: Both engines end-to-end on the same machine (i7-9750H, GTX 1660 Ti), both frontends GPU. COLMAP 4.1.0 CUDA defaults (SIFT + exhaustive + mapper) vs visloc SuperPoint-2048 + unordered_sfm_demo --colmap-style; both scored vs the dataset's shipped COLMAP reference by Sim(3).
comparisons.notes: Speed win (2.04x) AND closer agreement with the shipped reference than COLMAP 4.1's own re-run (0.39 vs 0.55 cm) -- an agreement-with-historical-COLMAP metric, not independent GT. Registration goes to COLMAP (100/100 vs 98/100, repetitive-facade stragglers). Independent-GT accuracy verdict (e.g. ETH3D) is future work.
